name: Bottles
overview: In Jeremiah 13:12-14, bottles symbolize the fullness and judgment that God declares upon the inhabitants of the land. The imagery of every bottle being filled with wine portrays the certainty of impending judgment, leading to drunkenness and strife among people. This passage highlights the severe consequences of sin, where God will not show mercy but will bring destruction, illustrating bottles as vessels of both God's remembrance and the ripe judgment awaiting sinners.
